messages:
Maya: Escalating from Support -> CS: trial org Aurora hitting repeated 502s for embeddings since ~08:40 PDT. Support restarted pods, issue persists. Need a short customer acknowledgement + enablement offer.
Ibrahim: Ack. Please paste last-success time + sample log.
Maya: Last success 08:38. Fail at 08:41. Log: ```ERROR embed-service upstream 502 model=embed-lite trace=tx-aa12 err="kv cache timeout"```
Sam: Ops questions: did support try fallback routing? If not, recommend routing to fallback-pool and bump KV TTL for the tenant.
Maya: Support can switch routes on our go-ahead. Draft comm (short): "Hi Aurora were aware of intermittent 502s affecting embeddings in your trial. Were routing your requests to alternate capacity now and will update within 60 minutes. Well follow with an RCA and offer an enablement session. Customer Success"
Ibrahim: Good. Renewal note: trial ends in 6 days; if outage >4h mark as renewal-watch and offer prioritized enablement + a one-week dedicated window if SLA impacted. Ill tag CRM accordingly.
Sam: Ops play: 1) route to fallback-pool 2) increase tenant KV TTL to 25s 3) enable verbose traces for 30m 4) monitor error-rate and p50 on dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/dash/prod-us-west-2
Maya: Please run the route-switch and post verification metrics. Ill send the ack once Sam confirms.
ops-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-us-west-2)  58 errors / 5m.
Sam: Route-switch executed at 3432106800. Verification: 12/13 requests OK, 1 transient 502. Verbose traces enabled.
ops-bot: [incident-update] INF-5588 mitigation applied (route-switch) at 3432106800.
Maya: Sent ack to Aurora at 3432106805 (copied here). Meeting: proposing 20-min sync with SE in 45m.
Ibrahim: CRM tagged "renewal-watch" and follow-ups created: postmortem, enablement invite, credit guidance if SLA breached.
Sam: Current error rate 0.9% over 10m. Keep traces for full 30m. Escalate to runtime-eng if >3% for 10m.
Maya: Action items: Sam (monitor & logs), Ibrahim (CRM + renewal play), Maya (comm + schedule call). Closing when <0.5% for 30m.
